name: Try to send from an empty wallet (clear stop message)
description: On a brand-new wallet with no money in it, trying to send ecash stops with a clear 'not enough balance' message instead of letting the user pick an amount they can't send.
details: Fresh wallet with zero balance everywhere: the Send method chooser opens unguarded, but tapping Create ecash stops at the insufficient-balance toast (machine NO_BALANCE) without ever reaching the amount screen; document both states and return home
